commits.title: Built pages' links stay in the app for an address of the app (BlockLink)

changes.how: No `"use client"` line needed (it only renders PolicyLink, which is the client part), no import from `@/lib/page-content`, no zod. Imports: `type { AnchorHTMLAttributes } from "react"`, `{ isPayPath } from "@/lib/pay-routes"`, `{ PolicyLink } from "./policy-link"`. Export `export function isAppAddress(href: string): boolean`: true only when ALL hold: `href` starts with exactly one `/` (`/^\/(?!\/)/`); `!isPayPath(href)`; the path part (before `?` or `#`) does not start with `/api/`, `/admin`, `/auth/`, `/oauth/` or `/r/`; and the last segment of the path part holds no file extension (`!/\.[a-z0-9]{2,5}$/i.test(lastSegment)`). Export `export function BlockLink({ href, plain = false, ...rest }: AnchorHTMLAttributes<HTMLAnchorElement> & { href: string; plain?: boolean })`: when `plain` is true, or `rest.target` is set, or `!isAppAddress(href)`, return `<a href={href} {...rest} />` exactly as the callers draw today; otherwise return `<PolicyLink policy="intent" href={href} {...rest} />`. Every other attribute (`className`, `style`, `aria-label`, `aria-hidden`, `tabIndex`, `rel`, `data-block-id`, `data-hover`, `data-button-frame`, `data-kz-text`, `children`) must pass through unchanged in both branches. Comment above it: built pages' links (D54) stay in the app for an address of the app; a pay path is always a full page load (docs/pci.md), as are files, handlers, new tabs and other sites.

Vitest. Part 1, `isAppAddress`: true for `/s/demo/no/p/x`, `/om-oss`, `/s/demo/no/category/a?sort=price`, `/no/blog/x#top`; false for `/s/demo/no/cart`, `/cart`, `/no/checkout`, `/s/demo/no/order/1`, `https://example.com`, `//example.com/x`, `#contact`, `mailto:a@b.no`, `tel:123`, `/downloads/a.pdf`, `/api/x`, `/admin`, `/admin/demo`, `/auth/callback`, `/oauth/authorize`, `/r/abc`, and the empty string. Part 2: `vi.mock("./policy-link", ...)` so PolicyLink renders `<a data-policy={policy} href={href} {...rest} />`; with `renderToStaticMarkup`, `<BlockLink href="/om-oss" className="x" data-block-id="b1">t</BlockLink>` holds `data-policy="intent"`, `class="x"` and `data-block-id="b1"`; with `plain`, with `target="_blank"`, and with `href="/s/demo/no/cart"` it holds no `data-policy`.

Import `{ BlockLink } from "./block-link"`. Add an optional prop `plain?: boolean` to `ContentGridView` and hand it down to `TileImage` (the function near line 273 that draws the picture links). Replace `` with ``) at exactly four anchors, keeping every attribute: the tile's title link (``, about line 147); the tile's button (`data-kz-text="button"`, about line 226); and the two picture links in TileImage (about lines 300 and 310). For an item with `item.external` true also pass `plain` (write `plain={plain || item.external}`), so an outside address the owner typed stays an anchor. Do NOT change the swatch links of a combined listing (`data-group-swatches`, about line 202): step 2.8 owns them.
Import BlockLink and replace the one anchor `<a href={item.href} className={`flex ${align} gap-2.5 hover:underline`}>` (about line 48) and its closing tag with `<BlockLink ...>`; same attributes.

In `ColumnLinkCover` (about line 448) replace the self-closing `<a href={column.link.href} aria-label={name} className=... />` with `<BlockLink ... />`, same attributes. Import BlockLink from `./block-link`.

Import BlockLink. `PageBlockView` already takes `preview` (true in the builder's canvas): pass `plain={preview}` at each replaced anchor; where the anchor is drawn by an inner function of this file that does not receive `preview`, add a `plain?: boolean` parameter to that function and pass `preview` from PageBlockView's switch. Replace `<a` with `<BlockLink` at exactly four anchors, keeping every attribute: the video's link (about line 180, `className="inline-block max-w-full focus-visible:outline-2"`); the picture's link (about line 246); the button (about line 302: keep `data-block-id={block.id}`, `data-button-frame`, `data-hover`, `style`, `className`); each side of the dual button (about line 366: keep `data-hover`, `data-kz-text={which}`). Where the anchor spreads `target: "_blank"` for `newTab`, leave that spread as it is: BlockLink returns a plain anchor whenever `target` is set.

Add a test in the `entering a pay route` describe: `a built page's link never client-navigates to a pay path`: read src/components/block-link.tsx and expect its text to contain `isPayPath(`; and import `isAppAddress` from `@/components/block-link` and expect false for `/s/demo/no/cart`, `/s/demo/no/checkout` and `/s/demo/no/order/1`. Leave the existing checkout scan (already widened to wrapper names by step 2.6) as it is.

The file is e2e/prefetch.spec.ts (made by step 1.3). Add the test `a press on a built page's tile stays in the app`: phone viewport 390x800 with touch; open /s/demo/no, wait for network idle; start collecting requests; tap the first product tile's title link inside the page's content grid (`page.locator("main article a[href*='/p/']").first()`); wait for the URL to match `/\/p\//` and then 3.5 s. Assert 0 requests with `resourceType() === "document"` and at most 8 requests in all (1 and 42 before). Add a second short test `a built page's link to the cart is a full page load`: make a page with one button whose href is `/s/demo/no/cart` using `storePageRows()` from e2e/db.ts, press it, and expect exactly 1 document request.

In the paragraph that starts `**Every entry into a pay route is a full page load**` add at its end: `A builder block's link (`BlockLink`, `src/components/block-link.tsx`) stays in the app only for an address that is not a pay path (`isPayPath()`); a block that points at a cart, checkout or order address is a plain anchor, and `PayRouteGuard` still reloads a pay page reached another way.`
